answer: Make identity expensive to replicate, not just to create. Each agent anchors to a hardware beacon that signs its work, and every newcomer must dock at a vouching harbor where several established, unrelated peers stake their own standing to admit it. Cloning then means cracking a fresh walnut of real compute plus winning independent vouchers each time; and if an admitted agent is later flagged as a sybil, its vouchers forfeit stake, so rubber-stamping fakes becomes self-defeating rather than free.
